name: Dean "Silent But Deadly" Roy
caption: A stoic, silent shoot-fighter introduced training at a Detroit wrestling school ahead of his federation debut, dispatching two enhancement opponents without ever speaking.

tenures.source: the federation's own debut vignette, 7 February 1999

notes: The vignette also co-signs its closing block with a second, non-competing name billed as the retired holder of an unrelated federation's cruiserweight title; that name is not minted here, since it never appears in this federation's own action.
